admissionRules: Record exact model and tokenizer/decoder revision plus artifact SHA-256.
Record code license, weight license, output terms, training-data disclosure level and commercial-use review separately.
Benchmark quality, acceptance rate, peak production memory, deterministic controls and failure modes on a fixed eval set.
Do not call a model FOSS solely because its inference code is open source.
Reject franchise-, character-, artist- or soundtrack-specific LoRAs, adapters and fine-tunes.
Reject models with unclear commercial output terms or without an acceptable near-duplicate and similarity evaluation.
Generated output remains quarantined until technical, visual, originality, performance and license gates pass.
